conviction_note: 0: the event is most likely Pantoro's FY2026 Annual Report after the close on 24 Sep. Its date is not confirmed, and the report adds little the market does not already have. Production (77,408 oz), June-quarter AISC, cash and gold (A$223.4M), FY27 guidance and quarter-to-date output were all disclosed between 9 Jul and 21 Sep 2026. The one piece that could matter is the annual Mineral Resource & Ore Reserve statement. The company dates it only as 'end of September', and I found no evidence for which way it would go.
bar: unsourced as a street number: consensus.quarters is empty and I found no FY26 NPAT consensus. The company's own disclosures are the de facto bar: FY26 production of 77,408 oz and FY27 guidance of 90-105 koz at A$2,800-3,400/oz AISC (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260709/pdf/071k8zzbxhcfk8.pdf, 2026-07-09); cash and gold of A$223.4M at 30 Jun 2026 and nil debt (https://www.fool.com.au/2026/07/30/pantoro-gold-posts-q4-2026-results-and-sets-sights-on-growth-at-norseman/); H1 FY26 NPAT of A$56.4M and net assets of A$569.8M (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260309/pdf/06x6t6w472ktt8.pdf). Every size is capped for that reason, and none was needed.
filer_type_check: The baseline says 'results', but the classifier gets this issuer wrong. All six 'results' rows in history are 'Quarterly Results Presentation' decks lodged on the same day as the Appendix 5B quarterly, so they are production and cash-flow reactions, and median_abs_move_results_only_pct of 10.91 measures quarterlies. The 24 Sep event is the Annual Report. Pantoro lodged no separate August Appendix 4E in 2024, 2025 or 2026. It lodged a non-price-sensitive Annual Report after the close on 26/09/2024 at 4:10pm and on 25/09/2025 at 4:16pm, and the next sessions moved 0.00% and +5.90% (the second on a gold-rally day). So I hunted what the annual report could reveal that is not already public: an impairment, a statutory profit surprise, the MROR, and a capital return.
event_check: NOT CONFIRMED, but not disproven either. The ASX 2026 archive (https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=PNR&timeframe=Y&year=2026) has nothing after 21/09/2026 8:29am (Operations Update & Investor Presentation). There is no notice of a results or annual-report date, no trading halt and no Appendix 4E. The vendor date fits the filing pattern: annual reports after the close on 26/09/2024 (https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=PNR&timeframe=Y&year=2024) and 25/09/2025 (https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=PNR&timeframe=Y&year=2025), with the Corporations Act deadline at 30 Sep. The 21 Sep release says the MROR will come 'end of September' (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260921/pdf/0749f6zytkwwch.pdf), which could put the annual report anywhere from 24 to 30 Sep. That is a cadence prior, not evidence that the report lands on 24 Sep.
session_check: amc if the pattern holds: both prior annual reports were lodged at 16:10-16:16 Sydney, after the 16:00 close (ASX 2024 and 2025 archives above). This is not verified for 2026 because no forward notice exists.
positioning_check: ASIC shows 2.3128% short as of 2026-09-17, up from 2.0479% on 2026-09-10 (+0.26pp, building), with a lag of 3 sessions. The build fits index-deletion arbitrage rather than a view on the print. S&P DJI's 4 Sep notice removed PNR from the S&P/ASX 200 effective before the open on 21 Sep (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260904/pdf/073rbz4q8nrckg.pdf). The rebalance close on 18 Sep traded 15.1m shares, against about 2-4m on a normal day. The stock has since risen 15% from the 17 Sep register date (2.61 to 3.01), so 'shorts building' most likely describes the deletion trade and has probably already been covered. The priced lean of +0.405 is mostly the short-squeeze term, and I cannot beat or contradict it with anything tied to the print. Regal Partners' long disclosures rose from 9.05% to 10.90% to 12.07% of shares (Form 604s of 26 Aug and 7 Sep: https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260826/pdf/0738ctmbq8nlj8.pdf and https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260907/pdf/073tlhbglwvlb7.pdf). Those are public and not specific to the print.

outside_window.finding: The annual Mineral Resource & Ore Reserve statement is dated only 'end of September'. The last statement put Ore Reserves at 859 koz. Since then FY26 depleted roughly 77 koz, the deeper OK underground had seismic and ground-pressure problems, and a higher gold-price deck and new open pits (Green Lantern, Gladstone Stage 3) push the other way. I found no directional evidence, and if the statement lands on 28-30 Sep it falls outside this window. If it comes out with the annual report on 24 Sep after the close, it falls inside the window, still unsigned.

The updated five-year plan was promised on 9 Jul for the September quarter, alongside the MROR. On 21 Sep it was pushed to the December quarter so that Racetrack can be included. The stock rose 3.6% that day, so the delay is already priced, and the plan itself resolves well after this window.

searched_and_found_nothing: Impairment trigger: net assets were A$569.8M at 31 Dec 2025 (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260309/pdf/06x6t6w472ktt8.pdf). Market cap at 30 Jun 2026 was about A$870M (389.7m shares at about A$2.23), above book, so there is no market-cap impairment indicator. Goodwill is A$32.0M and would be a non-cash one-off even if written down.

FY26 statutory NPAT: H1 was A$56.4M with a A$25M tax expense sheltered by carried-forward losses. H2 is inferable from the quarterlies (Q4 EBITDA A$44.8M). There is no street consensus to beat, and the annual report was not price-sensitive in either of the last two years.
Capital return: an on-market buy-back ran from Feb to Jun 2026, with no notices after 24 Jun 2026. I found nothing pointing to a dividend or a new buy-back in the annual report.
The Redpath contract renegotiation, 'ongoing' on 9 Jul. The 21 Sep update gave no outcome and I found no press on it.
Director dealing: the 18 Aug 2026 Appendix 3Y relates to the options/rights cessation and quotation lodged the same day. There has been no director selling since the Nov 2025 notices.
Stockhead, Proactive, Kalkine, Motley Fool and miningnews coverage of Sep 2026 covers Racetrack drilling and the 21 Sep ops update, all already in the price. Nothing mentions the annual report.
baseline_tension: Nothing I found cuts against or adds to the +0.405 lean or the run-up (+6.74% over 5 days, +9.06% over 20). The run-up is mostly the rebound after the ASX 200 deletion and the 21 Sep ops update, neither of which is about this print.
